verdicts.reason: Right gap, wrong artifact boundary. Breakers, cooldowns, health pings, and degraded flags need an executable shared runner/library plus thin skill docs; prose protocol alone will not prevent silent fallthrough.

Freshness check is real, but sharing an NB protocol across callers risks eroding WR3 Contract 2. Split routing/freshness metadata from call authority; only approved interpreters should load callable NB procedures.

This abstracts too little and risks homogenizing intentionally distinct reviewers. JSON shape and cap-3 can live in agent templates or tests; a shared review skill adds coupling without fixing rubric quality.
Starvation is upstream, not analyst logic. Keep a visible no-data gate and shared output schema, but do not build a correlation protocol until enough IG/YT observations exist to validate it.
Orchestrator contracts are load-bearing pipeline prose. A shared skill could blur WR2/WR3 differences and create false universality; enforce drift with contract tests or inventory checks instead.
This is the actual system failure, not another abstraction.

strongest_objection: Most proposals treat duplication of words as duplication of behavior. The real failure mode is non-enforcement: skills loaded as guidance will not guarantee breaker state, NB authority boundaries, orchestrator contracts, or loop closure without executable checks and receipts.
missed_gap: A contract-test/audit harness for the agent library: verify frontmatter skills load, WR3 NotebookLM exclusivity, reviewer!=author, inventory count, provider health, and required output artifacts.
